label: Sendline
command: if [ -n "${SENDLINE_HOME:-}" ]; then sendline_home="$SENDLINE_HOME"; elif [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ]; then sendline_home="$HOME/Library/Caches/sendline"; else sendline_home="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/sendline"; fi; exec "$sendline_home/runners/0.5.0" run --file "$ZED_FILE" --line "$ZED_ROW"
